controller_equivalence_requirements: Skipping physical materialization may retain exact candidate/menu order, commit/cursor, attempt journal, reason/diagnostic, zero-debit family/parent feedback, reserve/window lifetime and budget counters.

Removing proved-invalid menu entries changes zero-attempt limits, queue rotation/fallback timing, window saturation and refresh opportunities; treat it as a controller change and test, not free equivalence.
For composites precheck the first primitive on the original parent; subsequent checks use the successfully transformed intermediate IR. Do not test a derived task against the old parent.

Cost/catalogue/native failures, duplicate configurations and missing alias proof are distinct. Do not turn empirical low gain, poor predictor rank, one rejected parent or family-level failure counts into permanent hard pruning.

A current source proof rejection is conservative compiler unsupported behavior, not a proof that the mathematical transformation is impossible. A later graph/history/proof improvement can change legality.
